positions.coupling: both arms reduce the same VJP stream at the same fixed q; all d output directions retained
positions.q_distribution: one uniform q in range(16, encoded_length-1) independently per paragraph using Python random.Random(seed).randrange
positions.sampled_sum: sum over valid source positions p of d h_target[q] / d h_source[p]; no division by source count

control_contract.selection: fit01 chosen before any new fitting or recovery outcomes; all controls are conditional on this one calibration draw
control_contract.unsupported_sources: exclude unsupported target/self/after-target columns from both sides before scoring; never pad them as rank -1
